title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten map-ready Saint Peter blocks and corridors, each anchored by a named destination and one practical reason to stop.

cards.entity_name: 1000 block of South Minnesota Avenue at Minnesota Square Park
cards.title: Bring a Ball to Minnesota Square
cards.subtitle: 1000 block of South Minnesota Avenue
cards.notes: Head down South Minnesota Avenue with a ball or picnic; the 1000 block combines courts, tables, a playground, and the park pavilion.
cards.short_summary: A recreation-ready block with several options in one city park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists basketball and tennis courts, picnic areas, a playground, and a pavilion at Minnesota Square Park.
cards.access_notes: City park hours are 7 a.m.–10 p.m.; reserved pavilion features may not be available to drop-in visitors.

cards.entity_name: 1000 block of North Third Street at Hallett Park
cards.title: Follow the Trails Around Hallett’s Pond
cards.subtitle: 1000 block of North Third Street
cards.notes: Use the North Third Street parking entrance, then choose a walking or bike loop around Hallett’s Pond and its fishing pier.
cards.short_summary: A pond-side block suited to a walk, ride, or fishing stop.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists walking trails, a bike trail, a pond, and a fishing pier at Hallett Park.
cards.access_notes: Enter from the North Third Street parking lot and follow posted park and fishing rules.

cards.entity_name: 1400 block of Nicollet Avenue at Jefferson Park
cards.title: Meet Up by Jefferson Park’s Ballfields
cards.subtitle: 1400 block of Nicollet Avenue
cards.notes: Take Nicollet Avenue to the 1400 block for a field-side meetup; the park also supplies benches, picnic tables, and a playground.
cards.short_summary: A field-sports block with supporting picnic and play amenities.
cards.evidence_claim: The City describes Jefferson Park as a 13-acre complex containing four regulation softball diamonds.
cards.access_notes: Field availability can depend on scheduled sports; observe posted restrictions and city park hours.

cards.entity_name: 600 block of West Broadway Avenue at Johnson Park
cards.title: Pause at Saint Peter’s Pocket Park
cards.subtitle: 600 block of West Broadway Avenue
cards.notes: Break up a Broadway Avenue walk at the 600 block; compact Johnson Park offers a clearly marked pause without requiring a long detour.
cards.short_summary: A very small named park that makes an easy walking-route waypoint.
cards.evidence_claim: The City identifies Johnson Park at 601 West Broadway Avenue as Saint Peter’s smallest park, measuring 0.14 acre.
cards.access_notes: This is a compact outdoor stop rather than a full recreation complex; city park hours apply.

cards.entity_name: 1400 block of Leonard Street at McGill Park
cards.title: Walk the Urban-Forest Trails
cards.subtitle: 1400 block of Leonard Street
cards.notes: Turn onto Leonard Street for the 1400 block, where McGill Park’s play area opens into trails through its wooded nature area.
cards.short_summary: A neighborhood-park block with a wooded walking option.
cards.evidence_claim: The City describes McGill Park and its nature area as having walking trails through an urban forest, open green space, and a playground.
cards.source_title: McGill Park & McGill Park Nature Area | Facilities
cards.access_notes: Stay on designated paths, account for outdoor conditions, and observe city park hours.

cards.entity_name: 2000 block of Essler Drive at Prairie Ridge Park
cards.title: Use Prairie Ridge’s Shelter as a Turnaround
cards.subtitle: 2000 block of Essler Drive
cards.notes: Make the Essler Drive block your turnaround point on a longer outing; Prairie Ridge Park supplies a playground and shelter.
cards.short_summary: A simple northern waypoint with covered space and a play area.
cards.evidence_claim: The City identifies Prairie Ridge Park at 2033 Essler Drive as a neighborhood park with a playground and shelter.
cards.access_notes: Shelter reservations may take priority; check posted notices and use the park only during city park hours.

cards.entity_name: 2100 block of Meridian Street at Community Spirit Park East
cards.title: Choose a Field at Community Spirit Park
cards.subtitle: 2100 block of Meridian Street
cards.notes: Travel out Meridian Street to the 2100 block when your group needs field space; confirm school or league scheduling before setting up.
cards.short_summary: A sports-complex block beside Saint Peter High School.
cards.evidence_claim: The City locates Community Spirit Park East at 2100 Meridian Street and describes the combined park as a large outdoor sports complex beside the high school.
cards.access_notes: School activities and scheduled sports may affect availability; standard city park rules apply.

cards.entity_name: 500 block of Skaro Street at Veterans Memorial Park
cards.title: Pack Paddles for the Pickleball Courts
cards.subtitle: 500 block of Skaro Street
cards.notes: Aim for the Skaro Street side of the park with paddles and balls; verify court availability before committing to a match.
cards.short_summary: A recreation block anchored by public pickleball courts.
cards.evidence_claim: The City lists pickleball courts at Veterans Memorial Park, addressed at 500 Skaro Street and 311 North Fifth Street.
cards.access_notes: Bring your own equipment; courts may be occupied or scheduled, and city park hours apply.

cards.entity_name: 1500 block of Lloyd Lane at Warren Park
cards.title: Make Warren Park a Short Outdoor Stop
cards.subtitle: 1500 block of Lloyd Lane
cards.notes: Loop through the 1500 block of Lloyd Lane for a brief outdoor break at Warren Park and its clearly mapped play structure.
cards.short_summary: A small residential-block stop anchored by a named playground.
cards.evidence_claim: The City identifies Warren Park at 1500 Lloyd Lane as a neighborhood park with a GameTime play structure.
cards.access_notes: This is a neighborhood playground; be considerate of nearby homes and follow city park hours.

cards.entity_name: 300 block of South Minnesota Avenue at the Arts Center of Saint Peter
cards.title: Check the Arts Center Gallery
cards.subtitle: 300 block of South Minnesota Avenue
cards.notes: Walk the 300 block of South Minnesota Avenue and check the Arts Center’s current exhibition before browsing its gallery and shop.
cards.short_summary: A downtown arts block centered on exhibitions and performances.
cards.evidence_claim: The Arts Center says its facility at 315 South Minnesota Avenue provides exhibitions, performances, education, and community outreach.
cards.source_title: About | Arts Center of Saint Peter
cards.access_notes: Check the current program and posted hours before visiting; classes, performances, and shop purchases may have costs.
